source: Supplied graphics PNGs/tables + genuine reference-campaign controller screenshots. No ROM/executable access.
precision: screen coordinates are exact pixel-template fits; worldX uses supplied static camera registrations. Axe hue animation matched with exact foreground silhouette and exact grey shaft. Initial boss positions remain explicitly inferred.

bridge.method: Every8x16 strip RGB exactly matches supplied137 left/right identical119/121 columns; union only directly observed columns. Height16 is art bounds, native underside collision thickness unmeasured.

bowser.assembly: Front16x24 plus rear16x24 at x +/-16, y+8. Feet from rear origin+23; front bottom is not whole-body feet.

inferredInitial.uncertainty: Initial x is nearest16px grid to first paired live observation, not source spawn or activation state. y is measured bridge support. Animation scanline yields opaque feet160 or161 on support160.

bossPlatform.uncertainty: Real horizontal girder above Bowser; observed positions are not full path extrema or initial phase.

rescuedActor.uncertainty: Actor/player raw origins exact opaque-template fits. Nominal actor separation16; observed natural braking stops16..19px before the actor.8-4 uses continuous exact static ledge/NPC overlap to correct a16px tiled-background alias; final camera767, Mario895, Princess912.
